name: Shadows
description: Thieves and infiltrators who take what they want unseen.

typeUpgrades.name: Thief Rigging
typeUpgrades.description: You get 2 free load of tools or gear.

typeUpgrades.name: Underground Maps & Passkeys
typeUpgrades.description: You have easy passage through the underground canals, tunnels, and basements of the city.

typeUpgrades.name: Elite Rooks
typeUpgrades.description: Your Rooks cohorts get +1d to quality rolls for related actions.

typeUpgrades.name: Elite Skulks
typeUpgrades.description: Your Skulks cohorts get +1d to quality rolls for related actions.

typeUpgrades.name: Steady
typeUpgrades.description: Each PC gets +1 stress box. Costs three upgrades to unlock, not just one.

features.name: Everyone Steals
features.description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Prowl, Finesse, or Tinker (up to a max rating of 3).

features.name: Ghost Echoes
features.description: From weird experience or occult ritual, all crew members gain the ability to see and interact with the ghostly structures, streets, and objects within the echo of Duskvol that exists in the ghost field.

features.name: Pack Rats
features.description: Your lair is a jumble of stolen items. When you roll to acquire an asset, take +1d.

features.name: Patron
features.description: When you advance your Tier, it costs half the coin it normally would. Who is your patron? Why do they help you?

features.name: Second Story
features.description: When you execute a clandestine infiltration, you get +1d to the engagement roll.

features.name: Slippery
features.description: When you roll entanglements, roll twice and keep the one you want. When you reduce heat on the crew, take +1d.

features.name: Synchronized
features.description: When you perform a group action, you may count multiple 6s from different rolls as a critical success.

features.name: Veteran
features.description: Choose a special ability from another source.
